name: LM317 adjustable regulator
description: 1.25–37 V adjustable regulator: Vout = 1.25 V × (1 + R2/R1) + 50 µA × R2. Plugin example with its own SPICE subcircuit.

library:
.subckt LM317BB in adj out
* 1.25 V between OUT and ADJ, held by a pass element that only sources current
* (0 … 1.5 A) and needs 1.5–2.5 V of headroom; 50 µA flows out of ADJ. Three
* terminals, no ground pin: the quiescent current returns through OUT.
Bpass in out I={limit(1000*(v(adj)+1.25-v(out)), 0, 1.5)*limit(v(in)-v(out)-1.5, 0, 1)}
Iadj in adj DC 50u
Rleak in out 10Meg
.ends LM317BB
